We have an alternate medical-grade resin, R-22, available for a controlled run. Before I issue the engineering authorization for this alternate material, I need to hear from each of you on any constraints. Quality, process engineering, regulatory affairs, and production planning — please share any concerns or constraints you have so I can make an informed decision.
